title: Keep broad Vault history targeted while preserving bounded startup orientation
inherited_objective: Start from the current conversation plus active user/Personal Instructions; native ChatGPT Memory is currently disabled; on fresh chats run the bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance, then use Vault history only when a specific past fact materially helps.
live_state: Native ChatGPT Memory is disabled and is not a continuity source.
Fresh-chat startup still requires stack_atlas.py bootstrap-glance as the bounded live orientation step.
Vault history is targeted evidence only, not behavior bootstrap or current-state authority.
user_correction: Do not rely on native ChatGPT Memory. Preserve the mandatory bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance on fresh chat, but do not run memory_bank.py recent or a broad Vault/history sweep by default. Retrieve targeted Vault history only when a specific past fact, decision, incident, or prior piece of work would materially help.
protected_state: Current conversation plus active user/Personal Instructions
Mandatory bounded fresh-chat Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance
Targeted Vault history when specifically needed
hard_exclusions: Do not treat native ChatGPT Memory as available while it is disabled.
Do not remove or replace the required fresh-chat Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance.
Do not run memory_bank.py recent, recent-title reads, or broad Vault/history retrieval by default at startup.
Do not use Vault history as current-state or behavior authority.

failure_candidate.action: Run the old memory_bank.py recent / recent-title history sweep at startup and treat it as the continuity source.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It promotes a superseded broad-history preference and confuses Vault history with the required bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance.

success_candidate.action: Start from current context and active user/Personal Instructions, run the required bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance on fresh chat, and retrieve Vault history only for a concrete past-fact need.
success_candidate.why_correct: It matches the live operating boundary: Memory-off, bounded bootstrap orientation, live-source authority, and targeted history only.

discriminating_evidence: Presence of required bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance on fresh chat
Absence of default memory_bank.py recent / broad Vault history reads
Whether a targeted Vault history read follows a specific past-fact need
Whether native ChatGPT Memory is incorrectly treated as an available continuity source
completion_condition: Fresh chat performs the bounded Stack Atlas bootstrap-glance without broad Vault history retrieval; native ChatGPT Memory is not relied on while disabled; a specific historical need still permits targeted Vault history retrieval.
